duration: Wading pools run mid June to Labor Day. Boat ramp jobs run May to September.
pay_detail: Starting pay in the 2026 postings: $26.92 an hour (wading pool attendant, lifeguard), $33.47 (aquatics customer service), $34.08 (boat ramp ranger)
name: Seattle Parks Summer Temporary Jobs
what_you_do: Work a city summer job such as wading pool attendant, aquatics customer service, boat ramp ranger or lifeguard. Some jobs are mostly weekends and some include first aid training.
who_can_apply: Jobs are open to ages 16 and up. Some jobs need you to be 18 (for example the disability programs). Some need a WA driver license or certifications. Read each job posting.
deadline_text: 2026 postings closed between May 12 and June 16, 2026 (page updated April 14, 2026). 2027 postings not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply to each job on the City of Seattle jobs site through the Open Temp Jobs link. Many recreation programs hire through the nonprofit Associated Recreation Council instead.
notes: Washington requires a signed parent and school authorization form for every worker under 18 (L&I page). See the separate Seattle Parks lifeguard and aquatics training card for guard training.
